pathClassification.repository: Only paths under the exclusive fresh A2-R1 run are emitted repo-relative. Other repository reporting destinations are rejected.
pathClassification.ownedTemporary: A current-process tempfile.mkdtemp audit event registers an owned /tmp root. Reporting requires an existing current-UID root and a path below that root, with no symlink resolution difference. Output uses OWNED_TEMP/<registered-index>/<relative-path>.
pathClassification.unknownExternal: RuntimeError VALIDATION_REPORT_UNOWNED_PATH, never caught as PASS.

outputRouting.regression: The original reserve_validation_directory helper runs against an evidence-only root nested under this fresh run. pg.ROOT is restored immediately before test subprocess execution.
outputRouting.case35: Its test-owned temporary ROOT is preserved; the original helper executes unchanged, including the second mkdir collision and FileExistsError assertion.

testDiscovery: Same modules, suite construction, order, required count assertion and test IDs as old wrapper; discovery.json is additional reporting only.
stopPolicy: First failure/error/skip/XFAIL/XPASS stops; no retry or third wrapper correction.
